The '''Morgania system''' was located in the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Morganian/Legends|Morganian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Questal" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Morgan [[Star system/Legends|system]],"<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> in reference to the Morganian species,<ref name="Questal" /> was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article written by [[Glen Allison]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]]. The article placed it in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="Twinkle" /> and is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] named the system that was the origin point of the Morganians "Morgania" and placed it in grid square S-14.<ref name="TEA" />
